definitions.coherent: F(R,t)=sum_q exp(+2*pi*i*q.R) Fq(t)/sqrt(N); Fq already includes amplitude*exp(-2*pi*i*q.kick_cell)/sqrt(N). No second kick phase or amplitude multiplication. Units Ry/bohr.
definitions.connected: Reuse spatial_pair: C_order(R,Rref;t,s)=sum_q exp(+2*pi*i*q.(R-Rref))*Cq_order/N. AB and BA kept independently with each electronic/ionic/field initial-origin and total. Sym=(AB+BA)/2; comm=AB-BA. Units (Ry/bohr)^2.
definitions.participation: For an explicitly named selected scalar array z_R, w_R=|z_R|^2 and P=(sum w)^2/sum(w^2), effective cells, P/N dimensionless. Not atom participation, energy, full-state localization or entanglement. Zero sum is undefined (null), not localized.
definitions.distance: Exact minimum Euclidean distance between selected identical atom sites over BvK image translations using original lattice vectors in bohr. Geometry offsets cancel for the same selected original atom. Distance-resolved per-cell |C|^2 and normalized weights; RMS radius sqrt(sum w*r^2/sum w) in bohr. Not fitted exponential correlation length. Expose periodic outer-distance weight and finite boundary ambiguity.
definitions.reality: Retain all complex values. Report coherent/sym imaginary norm and commutator real norm, AB-conj(BA), origin sums, and q conjugacy defects. No clipping or symmetrization repair.
definitions.energy: Only existing mean diagnostics attached at an exactly authenticated matching q baseline boundary; no force-derived local energy density/current. No entanglement, lifetime, infinite-volume or late-time inference. Accuracy not certified.

oracle_cases: Independent SymPy exact 4-cell Fourier transform and real-space coupled canonical oscillator evolution, unequal t/s, nonzero kick/reference cell: coherent sqrtN, AB/BA 1/N, plus q sign and opposite q dagger convention.
Three independent original product-origin covariances propagated by one real-space transition: origin sum and sym/comm identities, nonzero field-origin.
Delta support gives participation1, uniform support gives4, all-zero gives undefined; original skew-cell closest-image distances independently bounded.
